Portronics Boosty 10K Powerbank – Premium 15W Wireless Magnetic Charging Solution

The Portronics Boosty 10K Powerbank is designed for users who demand speed, portability, and premium build quality in a compact charging solution. With a powerful 10000mAh battery capacity, this powerbank ensures uninterrupted power for smartphones, earbuds, and other USB-enabled devices throughout the day. Featuring 15W wireless magnetic charging and a 20W Type C PD output, it delivers fast and efficient charging whether you’re at home, traveling, or on the move.

Crafted using aluminium alloy material, the Portronics Boosty 10K Powerbank offers durability with a sleek, modern finish. Its 16mm slim thickness and lightweight design make it easy to carry in your pocket, backpack, or laptop bag. The elegant black color complements both professional and casual lifestyles, making it a reliable everyday power companion.

Fast & Wireless Magnetic Charging Convenience

Experience effortless charging with the 15W wireless magnetic 10000mAh powerbank that securely attaches to compatible smartphones for stable and efficient power transfer. The strong magnetic alignment ensures optimal charging performance without the hassle of cables. For users who prefer wired charging, the 20W Type C PD output supports fast charging for smartphones, tablets, and other compatible devices.

The supports multiple charging protocols, making it compatible with Android devices, iPhones, wireless earbuds, smartwatches, and more. Whether you need quick top-ups or full recharges, this powerbank delivers consistent and reliable power.

Premium Build with Slim & Lightweight Design

Built with a high-quality aluminium alloy body, this wireless magnetic is engineered for strength and heat resistance while maintaining a refined look. Despite its solid construction, the remains ultra-slim at just 16mm thickness, ensuring maximum portability without compromising battery capacity.

The lightweight design makes it ideal for frequent travelers, professionals, and students who require reliable backup power without carrying bulky accessories. Its compact form factor fits comfortably in one hand, making it perfect for daily use.

LED Battery Indicator for Smart Power Management

The integrated LED battery indicator allows you to easily monitor the remaining power level, helping you plan recharges in advance. This smart feature eliminates guesswork and ensures your devices stay powered whenever you need them.

Safety is a priority with the. It comes equipped with advanced protection against overcharging, overheating, short circuits, and voltage fluctuations, ensuring safe and stable charging for all connected devices.

  • 15W wireless magnetic charging for cable-free convenience

  • Premium aluminium alloy material for durability and style
  • Ultra-slim 16mm thickness with lightweight design

Ideal for Everyday & Travel Use

Whether you’re commuting, traveling, or working remotely, the ensures uninterrupted connectivity. Its combination of fast charging, wireless magnetic support, slim profile, and premium build makes it one of the best 10000mAh wireless available today.
